name: @rdev/desktop
description: Xpromptvs's dashboard renderer — bundled into the native app (app/)

scripts.build:renderer: esbuild src/renderer/main.ts src/renderer/e2e-row.ts src/renderer/permissions.ts src/renderer/publish-status.ts src/renderer/share-notice.ts --bundle --splitting --format=esm --target=es2022 --log-level=warning --outdir=dist/renderer
scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p dist/renderer && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/style.css dist/renderer/ && cp -R ../web/public/shellstorm dist/renderer/
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run typecheck:renderer && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:assets && npm run build:agents && node ../scripts/stamp-release.mjs write dist/renderer
scripts.build:all: npm run build:web && npm run build && npm run build:native
scripts.build:check: npm run build:web && npm run build && RDEV_APP_OUT="${RDEV_APP_OUT:-$PWD/release-check}" sh ../scripts/assemble-app.sh
scripts.package: npm run build:web && npm run build && sh ../scripts/assemble-app.sh release
